data.long_meaning: Mansing is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, which means 'Mind', 'Intellect', or 'Sage'. In Hindu mythology, the name is associated with wisdom and understanding. Mansing is believed to represent the divine intellect and the pursuit of knowledge. The name Mansing carries the meaning “Mind, Intellect, Sage” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mansing usually hope their child will grow to embody mind, intellect, sage and live with faith, good character and purpose.
